Question 6
?

Find the derivative of f(t)=(et+tan⁡t)i−5j+t2ln⁡tk with respect to t.

a
(et+sec2⁡t)j+2tln⁡tk
b
sec2⁡ti+(2tln⁡t+t)k
c
(et+sec⁡t)i+(2t2+t)j
d
(et+sec2⁡t)i−2j+(2tln⁡t+t)k
e
(et+sec2⁡t)i+(2tln⁡t+t)k
